pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit irregular, stellate, or oak-leaf geometries with low-contrast, feathered edge gradients. Patch density is moderate with significant variation in individual patch area across the flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The network consists of thick, light-cream pathways forming a continuous topological grid. Junction nodes are predominantly Y-shaped (tri-radial), maintaining a consistent pixel width of approximately 10-15% of the average patch diameter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents as a dense, dark brown linear structure with a fine-grained, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The amplitude of individual hair tufts is minimal relative to the neck width.
